_about: Keyword rules: the backup way to assign an HS code before any AI. A rule fires when ONE of its `words` appears (whole word, plural optional) in the English product name and none of its `not` words or of `global_not` does; the first matching rule wins, so specific rules come first. `code` is the 6-digit code of the fresh / chilled product, `frozen_code` the one when the name or the store category says "frozen" (null: not suggested when frozen). A suggestion is never saved by itself: a person confirms it. The codes are checked against Comtrade's HS reference by the tests. Edit hs keyword rules in data/build_hs_keyword_rules.py (the editable table) and rebuild, or edit this file directly.
